HasExtraCardText.rationale: presentation only: read solely by EnchantmentModel.DynamicExtraCardText (EnchantmentModel.cs:60-81) and the card-UI nodes; no game-state reader. Out of scope per the shared contract's 'presentation/animation' waiver.

CanEnchant.maps_to: GoopyEnchantment.can_enchant (enchantments.py:285-287) -- base plus `"defend" in card.tags`, matching Goopy.cs:16-23. Enchantment.can_enchant (enchantments.py:51-61) + the subclass override. Base CanEnchant (EnchantmentModel.cs:273-294) rejects CardType 4/5/6 (Status/Curse/Quest), then CanEnchantCardType, then an Unplayable card whose pile is PileType.Deck, then a card that already has a (non-stackable) enchantment. The sim folds CanEnchantCardType into each subclass's own can_enchant and replaces the pile-qualified Unplayable test with an unconditional `not card.is_playable` -- equal in practice because every ported grant enchants a DECK card (probe `grants`).

EnchantBlockAdditive.maps_to: GoopyEnchantment.modify_block_additive (enchantments.py:298-301) -- returns `amount - 1` for its own card, matching Goopy.cs:44-47's `base.Amount - 1`. Additive-only, so BR-1's phase difference cannot bite here: base + sum(adds) is the same fold either way (executed control in `py tools/audit/enchantment_probes.py order`). First-play block with Amount 1 is 5 in both (`py tools/audit/enchantment_probes.py goopy`).

AfterCardPlayed.maps_to: GoopyEnchantment.on_card_played (enchantments.py:303-305) -- `amount += 1` for its own card, matching Goopy.cs:30-42's `base.Amount++`. The C# line the sim has no counterpart for, `base.Card.DeckVersion.Enchantment.Amount++` (Goopy.cs:37-40), is a no-op for the sim: the sim has ONE Enchantment object shared by the run and the combat, so the growth already persists (executed: `py tools/audit/enchantment_probes.py goopy` -- Amount is 2 after one play and survives reset())
AfterCardPlayed.issue: Per-replay firing. See guard EG1: C# runs AfterCardPlayed once per Replay iteration, the sim's on_card_played once per card play. EXECUTED (`py tools/audit/enchantment_probes.py replay`): Goopy(1) on a Defend played twice by the ported Throwing Axe relic leaves Amount at 2 in the sim and 3 in the game, and the player gains 10 block instead of 11 (game: 5 on the first play, then Amount becomes 2 so 5 + 1 = 6 on the second).
